investigation_notes.Description: A large volume of SharePoint downloads (420 files vs a 24-hour baseline of 45) was observed from the Finance_Reporting site by a Finance department user. The account belongs to a Senior Accountant and the activity originated from Tallinn at 11:15 local time using a standard browser user-agent, which aligns with normal business hours and the expected site for this role. No recent related events or similar alerts were found, and the accessed paths are consistent with finance and payroll reporting duties, so the activity is assessed as Low Priority. The high volume and presence of payroll/invoice files increase sensitivity and justify continued monitoring despite current evidence supporting authorized business activity.
